campaign.primary: Eight fixed paired tasks, four per hard fixture, order balanced within fixture. Both use preload, one request, identical prompt/native strict JSON Schema and 4096 cap; only reasoning effort differs (default omitted versus explicit low). Primary: truncation and full executable quality; secondary schema validity, parseability, provider completion, wall latency and tokens. Exact paired discordance tests; stratified paired bootstrap for continuous metrics. No exclusions by quality, retries or repairs. Unique cache key per call; stop on nonzero/unknown cached usage. 100000-token budget, 32768 reservation per pair.
campaign.qualityCriteria: Same strict output schema evaluated in BOTH arms, 11 functional/nonmutation cases, three regression examples failing original code, 120-160 words. Provider completion alone is insufficient.
